chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amer narrated to us, from his uncle 'Abdullah ibn 'Amer, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hamza ibn Humran, from his father, from Abu Hamza, from 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father, from Amir al-Mu'minin (blessings of Allah upon them all),
that a man came to him and said: O Abu al-Hasan! You are called the Commander of the Faithful; so who appointed you over them? He (AS) said: Allah, Exalted is His Majesty, appointed me over them.

So the man came to the Messenger of Allah (SAWW) and said: O Messenger of Allah! Does 'Ali speak the truth? The Prophet became enraged and said: 'Ali is the Commander of the Faithful through guardianship from Allah. He awarded it above His Throne and made His angels witness that 'Ali is the vicegerent and Proof of Allah, and the Imam of the Muslims. His obedience is coupled with obedience of Allah and his disobedience with disobedience of Allah.

So whoever was ignorant of him was ignorant of me, and whoever recognised him recognised me. Whoever denied his Imamate denied my prophethood, whoever denied his rulership denied my messengership. Whoever refuted his superiority lowered me, whoever fought him fought me, whoever insulted him insulted me, for he is from me, created from my clay. He is the husband of Fatima and the father of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.

Then he (SAWW) said: I, 'Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and nine from the descendants of al-Husayn are the Proofs of Allah upon His creation. Our enemies are the enemies of Allah, and our friends are the friends of Allah.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Imam Ali's title of Amir al-Mu'minin?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an exchange where a man questioned Imam Ali's title of Amir al-Mu'minin. When the man took the question to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), the Prophet became angry and delivered a powerful declaration affirming that Ali's authority was divinely appointed above the Throne, and that any hostility toward Ali is equivalent to hostility toward the Prophet himself. The Prophet concluded by naming the fourteen infallibles as the Proofs of Allah over creation.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
